title: Scate
summary: SCATE, noun [This word may belong to the root of shoot, and Latin scateo.] A wooden shoe furnished with a steel plate for sliding on ice. SCATE, verb intransitive To slide or move on scates. SCATE, no

inlines.v: SCATE, noun [This word may belong to the root of shoot, and Latin scateo.] A wooden shoe furnished with a steel plate for sliding on ice. SCATE, verb intransitive To slide or move on scates. SCATE, noun [Latin squatina, squatus.] A fish, a species of ray.
